children: By WSJ. Magazine editors | Photography by Elizabeth Arvelos Coetzee for WSJ. Magazine

I love accessories with a sense of humor. When dashing between appointments, this woven leather clutch from Bottega Veneta looks like a newspaper tucked under my arm. -Caitie Kelly, Senior Market Editor, Women's

A gold necklace is an essential no matter the occasion. This Tiffany & Co. necklace looks great peeking out from under a collared shirt, but can also be dressed down with a tank top and jeans. -Sarah Adams, Accessories & Jewelry Editor

Looking for new New York ephemera? Get the classic bodega cup of joe look but with more permanence to withstand your morning commute with this ExceptionLab coffee cup from the MoMA design store. -Lily Jane O'Brien, Assistant Market Coordinator

As a devotee of minimalist design, I find this wall clock so captivating. Drawing inspiration from Montblanc's Modern 47 line, it blends a timeless black dial with sleek hands and an iconic brushed stainless steel dot to elevate any interior. -Rashad Minnick, Senior Fashion Market Editor, Men's

Anyone with an office job knows...you sit at your desk quite a bit. Don't you want something that was designed with methodical intention? With vibrant design? Look no further with these Craighill Chroma Scissors. -Costa Moore, Fashion Assistant
